description: The Feywood's dominant oak lineage, basin-analog grown to older, broader proportions under the Feywood's conditions. Long-lived and habitat-rich; its mast supports silverbough hart, Feywoodhorn stag, and the canopy squirrel population across the outer wild.

ecology.cultural_role: structural wood for sanctioned deadfall harvest
ecology.ecological_role: major canopy tree; mast producer; habitat support

name: High Oak
